messages:
maria_support: Escalation from ACME — they report a sharp drop in embeddings vectors/sec yesterday evening. tokens/sec looks normal, but vectors/sec down ~70% for a sustained window. Customer saw 429s and intermittent 502s. They attached repro steps and sample payloads. Raising to infra + eng so we can triage.

aj_eng: Thanks — can you paste the repro curl + headers and the reported model name/variant? Any dim mismatch errors reported?

maria_support: Sample request they sent: 
```
curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"embed-small-1","input":["doc text..."...] }'
```
They reported sometimes getting back 512-dim vectors and sometimes 768-dim for the same client workload. Also auth retries noted in their logs (401 then 200).

sam_infra: Pulled infra logs for org_id=acme-corp around 2026-03-14T18:15-19:15Z. Observed: GPU queue depth spikes on host gpu-12, autoscaler spun up nodes but join latency ~45s. KV cache hit rate for embeddings prefix dropped ~30% at 18:23.

kai_sre: Was there any routing or autoscaler rollout in that window?

aj_eng: We did a small canary earlier that changed routing preference to try lower-cost quantized variants under high load and bumped the batching window from 20ms -> 50ms for some high-concurrency paths. That could increase per-request latency and larger batches, but the dim-mismatch + vectors/sec drop suggests some requests were routed to a different model variant (embed-small-512) as a capacity fallback.

maria_support: Customer insists they didn't change client; they send steady streams of docs expecting 768-dim vectors. They observed 512 dims in a portion of responses and also saw increased tail latency.

sam_infra: Confirmed: model-mapping-service returned variant embed-small-512 for ~42% of ACME requests during the regression window due to a fallback policy when certain hosts were saturated. Also saw auth-service introspection returning 401s then successful retries — those retries doubled the effective per-request work and pushed queues higher.

aj_eng: That explains dim mismatch and perf change. Proposed immediate mitigations: (1) pin acme-corp to embed-small-768 variant on their shard, (2) increase token-introspection cache TTL to reduce auth load, (3) limit max_batch_tokens in serving config to cap batch growth. Who can run the repro with the customer's sample load?

maria_support: I'll coordinate with ACME to run a scheduled replay. Can infra pin them meanwhile?

sam_infra: Done — pinned org acme-corp -> variant embed-small-768 on shard s-3. Also temporarily scaled gpu-12 pool by +2 nodes and set serving config: max_batch_tokens=2048 to limit batch expansion.

kai_sre: Did a quick replay locally (their sample, 500 req/s). Reproduced vectors/sec drop and intermittent 502s under auth 401 storm. Trace snapshot: `router->auth(401)->retry->route->gpu-queue(wait=120ms)->serve->timeout(1s)->502` — retries are definitely amplifying pressure.

aj_eng: Follow-ups: add a routing guard so we avoid switching variants for requests already in-flight; tag fallback decisions with metric 'variant_fallback' so alerts can catch spikes; open a small PR to add de-dup for billing on retries. I'll prioritize PR today.

maria_support: Customer upgrade: pin accepted, they asked for a short postmortem and assurance this won't happen again. What's ETA for the PR and a mitigation rollout?

aj_eng: I'll open the PR (routing guard + metric tag) today. Deploy to canary tomorrow morning (low-traffic region). Ops: can infra push the introspect cache TTL change now as a hotfix?

sam_infra: Applied hotfix: introspect_cache_ttl 30s -> 300s for edge auth. Observed immediate auth call rate drop ~65% for that org; GPU queue depth returned to baseline within ~3 minutes.

ops_bot: Incident created INC-2026-0314-vec-throughput, assigned to aj_eng, sam_infra.

kai_sre: Note on billing: retries caused duplicate billed tokens in some windows. Recommend billing layer de-dupe by request_id within a short window to prevent spikes.

maria_support: Noted and added billing de-dupe to the postmortem action items. Will update ACME and close escalation if metrics look stable for 24h. :thumbsup:
